verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires a live hosted application that is accessible for review, establishing the deployment behavior and review context.
The client identifies Vercel and Heroku as acceptable hosting options for the live testing environment, adding an implementation-relevant infrastructure preference.
First concrete failure: complete hosted testing is unavailable because the backend has not been deployed, directly showing that the review environment is not operational.
The client explicitly rejects local execution as an acceptable review method, establishing remote accessibility as a concrete deployment acceptance condition.
